The '''siblipede''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of small [[Insect/Legends|insect]] native to [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Ottega sector/Legends|Ottega sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. They often fed in groups upon the decaying leaves on the [[Tree/Legends|forest]] floor. Siblipedes were preyed on by [[manollium]] [[Bird/Legends|birds]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The siblipede was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in [[2009]].<ref name="TEA" />
